grh_7339f50bda75bc2fa1e0.title: Bohemian Star
paragraphs: Harry learns that jewel thieves are after the Bohemian Star, a huge diamond, and tries to get into the deal himself. The thieves kidnap and drug him, planning to keep him quiet until they can escape with the stone, but Harry turns the tables and takes possession of the diamond. When Scotland Yard officers reveal they have been hidden nearby listening, Harry immediately presents himself as the honest man who recovered the jewel for its rightful owner. He returns the Bohemian Star for a reward, later admitting that the visible tip of a policeman's shoe behind a curtain had a great deal to do with his sudden honesty.
